title: Legal Determination Mobile Voice Termination Rate for Special Numbering Services
text:
DETERMINATION OF
MOBILE (VOICE)
TERMINATION RATE FOR
SPECIAL NUMBERING SERVICES
SEGMENT
Issued by
NIGERIAN COMMUNICATIONS COMMISSION
This 24th Day of September, 2022

DETERMINATION OF MOBILE (VOICE) TERMINATION RATE FOR
SPECIAL NUMBERING SERVICES SEGMENT
INTRODUCTION:
A. The Special Numbering Service is a Value Added Service, introduced into the Nigerian market
in 2006 to make communication easier for companies and individuals who would want
customised and easily memorisable ways of reaching out to them such as 0700CALLNCC.
B. There are currently only twenty five (25) active licensees rendering this service offering. The
service became out of reach to subscribers due to charges by operators and the revenue
generation by the service provider(s) was also very poor. This was due to high cost of
interconnect tariffs and settlements on the 0700 and 0800 lines. The high charges to the
subscribers occasioned by high termination cost discouraged the use of the service which led to
near collapse of this market segment.
C. Arising from this, the Commission severally engaged the relevant stakeholders with a view to
arriving at a Cost Based Determination that would address the challenges in the market segment.
D. The Committee's investigations revealed that the tariffs charged by MNOs for Special
Numbering Licensees (SNL) using the 0800 numbering range were as follows:
a. ₦15 for all incoming calls to a SNL Service Provider
b. ₦3.90 per minute for interconnect to MNOs
c. ₦4.70 per minute for interconnect to small operators (Fixed networks)
d. ₦3.00 per minute as Value Added Service (VAS) charge
Any subscriber that uses the 0800 toll free service is charged a total of either N21.90 per minute
(Mobile Network) or N22.70 per minute (Fixed Network).
E. The Charges by the various operators for the 0700 numbering range were as follows:
a. MTN to SNL ₦12 per minute
b. Airtel to SNL ₦14 per minute
c. Glo to SNL ₦45 per minute
d. 9Mobile to SNL ₦25 per minute
e. VAS charge
₦3.00 per minute
F. Arising from this, the Commission met severally with the relevant stakeholders with a view to
arriving at an acceptable rate using a cost based Determination.
G. The final Stakeholders engagement took place on December 15, 2021 where the Commission
presented the proposed cost model to be used in developing the Determination. This was well
received and accepted by all stakeholders.
Based on the forgoing, the Commission hereby determines as follows:
1. That the tariff to be charged for the Non Toll-Free Number is N12.00.
This is broken down as follows:
Total Price/Minute = Floor Price + MNO Margin + VAS Charge + VAT
= ₦6.40 + ₦2.77+ ₦2.00 + ₦0.83 = ₦12.00
2. That the tariff to be charged for the Toll-Free Number is N10.75.
This is broken down as follows:
Total Price/ Minute= Floor Price + MNO Margin + VAS Charge + VAT
= ₦6.40+ ₦1.40 + ₦2.00 + ₦0.75 = ₦10.75

3. That all operators must ensure strict compliance and seek approval of the Commission in line
with this Determination.
4. This Determination shall take effect from November 1, 2022 and shall remain in force until
reviewed/amended by the Commission.
5. The Commission reserves the right to amend this Determination at any time especially where
there are significant changes to the input parameters.
Dated this 24th day of September, 2022
Prof. U.G Danbatta, FNSE, FRAES, FAEng, FREAS, FNIEEE
Executive Vice Chairman/CEO
